Name: Bit-depth and sample reduction
Description: Quantized lo-fi processing using the acrusher algorithm.

Name: Audio derivative transform
Description: First-difference sample transform; this is mathematical processing, not restoration.

Name: Audio integral transform
Description: Integrate samples and bound the resulting peaks with a limiter.

Name: Spectral dynamic-range control
Description: Frequency-domain compression above a fixed reference level.

Name: Detected-band dynamic equalization
Description: Use detected-band dynamic equalization with explicit cut-above behavior.

Name: Adaptive dynamic smoothing
Description: Apply the backend dynamic smoothing algorithm.

Name: Audio wavelet denoising
Description: Wavelet-domain noise reduction with a fixed bounded noise estimate.

Name: One-second audio phrase repetition
Description: Repeat the first decoded second once within the bounded exported excerpt.

Name: Non-local means audio denoising
Description: Patch-based audio noise reduction; processing cost depends on the installed filter.

Name: Finite audio tail padding
Description: Add up to one second of silence after natural end, within the output-duration cap.

Name: Psychoacoustic clipping reduction
Description: Apply the psychoacoustic clipping algorithm to peaks; not lost-signal reconstruction.

Name: Subharmonic bass reinforcement
Description: Apply sub-bass reinforcement without changing the output-device configuration.

Name: Steep subsonic removal
Description: High-order subsonic cutoff at 30 Hz.

Name: Steep ultrasonic removal
Description: High-order cutoff above 20 kHz at the working sample rate.

Name: High-order Butterworth pass band
Description: Use the separate high-order Butterworth band-pass algorithm.

Name: High-order Butterworth rejection band
Description: Use the high-order Butterworth band-stop algorithm.

Name: Spectral tilt transform
Description: Apply the spectral tilt algorithm independently of the shelving-EQ implementation.

Name: Bauer binaural crossfeed
Description: Use libbs2b-style crossfeed when the installed FFmpeg includes that filter.

Name: Distance-derived acoustic delay
Description: Apply the acoustic propagation delay corresponding to one metre, with backend temperature defaults.

Name: HDCD PCM decoding
Description: Decode HDCD markers before resampling; requires an appropriate decoded 16-bit source.

Name: Rubber Band pitch processing
Description: One-semitone pitch transformation using the optional Rubber Band implementation.

Name: Leading-silence trimming
Description: Trim leading audio below the configured fixed silence threshold.

Name: Stereo phase and image processor
Description: Apply a 15-degree stereo phase transformation with stereotools.

Name: Eighteen-band presence processing
Description: Use the separate eighteen-band equalizer algorithm with a fixed presence emphasis.

Name: Virtual bass harmonic synthesis
Description: Synthesize the backend virtual-bass effect; not hardware bass management.

Name: Temporal pixel-difference amplification
Description: Amplify temporal pixel differences with a bounded five-frame neighborhood.

Name: Average-neighborhood smoothing
Description: Apply separable neighborhood averaging.

Name: Box-kernel picture smoothing
Description: Apply a bounded box blur.

Name: CIE chromaticity scope rendering
Description: Render a CIE chromaticity diagram from the input picture.

Name: Decoded motion-vector visualization
Description: Draw exported decoder motion vectors when the codec supports them.

Name: HSL colorization
Description: Blend a fixed HSL tint using the colorize algorithm.

Name: Selected-color isolation
Description: Retain colors near red and desaturate the rest.

Name: BT.601-to-BT.709 YUV matrix correction
Description: Explicit matrix correction for a source known to use BT.601; not automatic source detection.

Name: Spatial convolution edge processing
Description: Apply a spatial 3-by-3 sharpening kernel to luma.

Name: Spline-based RGB contrast curve
Description: Use a spline contrast curve rather than a linear channel matrix.

Name: Pixel-value inspection visualization
Description: Overlay the backend pixel-value datascope.

Name: Directional motion blur
Description: Apply directional blur along a 45-degree axis.

Name: DCT-domain denoising
Description: Apply discrete-cosine-domain picture denoising.

Name: Codec-block boundary smoothing
Description: Smooth eight-pixel coding-block boundaries with the weak algorithm.

Name: Fixed-cycle duplicate-frame decimation
Description: Drop a duplicate candidate per five-frame cycle; use appropriate telecined sources.

Name: Cross-color and dot-crawl reduction
Description: Apply the dedicated dot-crawl/cross-color suppression algorithm.

Name: Local pixel-minimum deflation
Description: Apply local morphological deflation.

Name: Cadence judder correction
Description: Correct uneven frame timing using the backend cadence algorithm.

Name: Morphological picture dilation
Description: Use the dedicated local-maximum dilation filter.

Name: Picture reference-rectangle overlay
Description: Draw a visible reference rectangle in scaled-frame coordinates.

Name: Picture alignment-grid overlay
Description: Draw a translucent alignment grid.

Name: Canny-style edge visualization
Description: Render detected picture edges.

Name: Codebook color quantization
Description: Quantize picture colors with an ELBG codebook.

Name: EPX pixel-art enlargement
Description: Use EPX edge-aware pixel-art scaling before the final output-size cap.

Name: Morphological picture erosion
Description: Use a local-minimum erosion filter.

Name: Edge-directed spatial-temporal deinterlacing
Description: Use the ESTDIF deinterlacer when present in the installed backend.

Name: Exposure-domain brightness correction
Description: Raise exposure by half a stop using the exposure filter.

Name: Timed video fade-in
Description: Fade the first second of the selected excerpt from black.

Name: Frequency-domain picture filtering
Description: Apply a smooth low-pass frequency-domain weighting.

Name: Single-field extraction
Description: Extract top fields as half-height pictures.

Name: Interlaced field-order conversion
Description: Request bottom-field-first ordering for appropriately marked interlaced input.

Name: Edge border reconstruction
Description: Reconstruct a two-pixel edge border by smearing neighboring values.

Name: Connected-region color fill
Description: Fill the connected corner region using component destination values.

Name: Fast postprocessing artifact reduction
Description: Apply fast simple postprocessing at bounded quality.

Name: Gaussian picture smoothing
Description: Apply Gaussian spatial smoothing.

Name: Gray-world white balance
Description: Use gray-world illuminant estimation; source assumptions require review.

Name: Gray-edge illuminant correction
Description: Use gradient-based illuminant estimation.

Name: HQx pixel-art enlargement
Description: Use HQ2x pixel-art scaling before the final output-size cap.

Name: HSV-selected color isolation
Description: Retain a selected HSV neighborhood with the dedicated HSV hold filter.

Name: Local pixel-maximum inflation
Description: Apply local morphological inflation.

Name: Progressive-frame field interleaving
Description: Interleave progressive pictures into fields for offline picture transformation; container interlace certification is not claimed.

Name: Scharr edge visualization
Description: Render picture gradients with the Scharr operator.

Name: xBR pixel-art enlargement
Description: Use the separate xBR pixel-art enlargement algorithm before the final size cap.

Name: Finite video phrase repetition
Description: Repeat the first 25-frame phrase once within the final excerpt-duration cap.

Name: Chroma vectorscope rendering
Description: Render a chroma vectorscope, distinct from the audio stereo vectorscope.

Name: Luma-threshold mask generation
Description: Generate a threshold-based luma mask.

Name: Median picture denoising
Description: Apply bounded median-neighborhood filtering.

Name: Weighted monochrome conversion
Description: Convert to monochrome using the dedicated chroma-weighted algorithm.

Name: Picture color inversion
Description: Invert decoded picture values.

Name: Synthetic picture grain injection
Description: Add bounded temporal uniform grain.

Name: Picture-line oscilloscope overlay
Description: Visualize picture-line values with the video oscilloscope filter.

Name: Flashing-pattern reduction attempt
Description: Apply the backend flashing reduction algorithm; not a medical safety guarantee.

Name: Block-pixelation processing
Description: Apply sixteen-pixel picture pixelation.

Name: Prewitt edge visualization
Description: Render gradients using the Prewitt operator.

Name: Luma-to-pseudocolor visualization
Description: Render a viridis pseudocolor mapping for inspection.

Name: Mixed-telecine field reconstruction
Description: Attempt field matching on suitable mixed telecined sources.

Name: Equirectangular-to-flat panorama view
Description: Create a fixed rectilinear view from a known equirectangular panorama; no projection detection.

Name: Roberts edge visualization
Description: Render gradients using the Roberts operator.

Name: Shape-adaptive picture smoothing
Description: Use shape-adaptive luma/chroma blur.

Name: Animated picture scrolling
Description: Apply a bounded horizontal scroll velocity.

Name: Field-to-frame separation
Description: Separate interlaced fields into half-height frames.

Name: Geometric picture shear
Description: Apply a horizontal shear to the scaled picture.

Name: Selective saturation enhancement
Description: Use the vibrance algorithm for selective saturation changes.

Name: Adjacent-frame order permutation
Description: Swap adjacent frame positions in each two-frame group.

Name: Deterministic pixel permutation
Description: Permute picture pixels with a fixed seed.

Name: Undecimated-wavelet picture denoising
Description: Use the separate vague wavelet-denoising implementation.

Name: Sobel edge visualization
Description: Render gradients with the Sobel operator.

Name: Simple-postprocessing artifact reduction
Description: Apply simple postprocessing at a bounded quality level.

Name: Two-frame temporal difference visualization
Description: Render differences between consecutive pictures.

Name: Progressive-to-telecine cadence generation
Description: Generate a 2:3 field cadence from suitable progressive sources.

Name: Temporal histogram visualization
Description: Render temporal picture-histogram changes.

Name: Temporal field interleaving
Description: Interleave temporal fields using top-first ordering.

Name: Temporal median denoising
Description: Apply a bounded three-frame temporal median.

Name: Video-component waveform scope
Description: Render video signal-component waveforms, distinct from audio waveform images.

Name: Unsharp-mask picture sharpening
Description: Apply luma unsharp masking with a fixed spatial kernel.
